inputs.text:
Re-photograph this exact portrait as a natural high-end photographic portrait of the same person.

Keep exactly the same head direction, viewing angle, facial identity, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jaw, cheekbones, hair, mole placement, clothing, crop, framing, lighting direction and background.

Do not turn, rotate or move the head. Do not change the viewing angle. Do not redesign, beautify, age, symmetrize or replace his face.

Regenerate ONLY the photographic surface and the skin material: natural visible pores, fine skin micro-texture, natural skin grain, subtle skin tone variation, individual eyebrow hairs, realistic short stubble with visible skin between the hairs, a few fine flyaway hair strands.

The realism must come from a real photographic skin surface with genuine micro-detail, not from sharpening. Keep restrained film grain and natural color, and keep the same photographic rendering, lighting and color grading as the input image.

Do not smooth the skin excessively. Do not create airbrushed, plastic, porcelain, waxy, polished or beauty-filter skin. Do not add freckles, dark spots or scattered dark speckles.

Both eyes are clean and symmetrical, and both inner eye corners (medial canthus) are flat, smooth and unobtrusive. There is no raised fleshy lump, no enlarged or swollen caruncle, no nodule, no bump, no growth, no skin tag, no pterygium and no swelling at the inner corner of either eye. The inner corner of each eye is only a normal flat fold of skin with no protrusion.
